sloka: ततः कार्ष्णायसं शूलं कण्टकैर्बहुभिर्वतम् ।प्रगृह्याभ्यहनद्देवं स्तनयोरन्तरे दृढम् ।। ७.८.१५ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ kārṣṇāyasaṁ śūlaṁ kaṇṭakairbahubhirvatam ।pragṛhyābhyahanaddevaṁ stanayorantare dṛḍham ।। 7.8.15 ॥

translations.english: Then, seizing a black iron spear covered with many spikes, Malyavan firmly struck the god between his breasts.
